purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Bogura district’s official Record Room page states that certified land records and maps are supplied locally. The national DLRS Settlement portal and Ministry of Land map portal provide map/mouza/plot-oriented workflows; the Settlement portal explicitly limits its displayed khatians to ongoing survey mouzas and draft stages. No public full-polygon schema or WUP-point feature was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bogura district Record Room page lists certified land-record copies and maps.
Official DLRS portal identifies the Land Records and Surveys Department and links map-display and mouza-search workflows; it states displayed khatians are draft/ongoing-survey only.
Official Ministry of Land map portal describes digitization/georeferencing of mouza map sheets and selectors for district, upazila, mouza, sheet and plot.
Official DLRS Digital BRS page embeds map/khatian workflow.
Official DLRS guidance says final mouza maps may be collected through settlement office publication camps; this is not a vector API.
